description: This Java class 'ShippingEstimateWrapper' encapsulates the logic for estimating shipping costs, available shipping methods, and delivery times within the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It interacts with entities like ProductStore and ShoppingCart, and calls external services to fetch shipping estimates and times based on shipping methods and cart details.

classes.name: ShippingEstimateWrapper
classes.description: Handles calculation and retrieval of shipping options, estimates, and delivery times based on shopping cart data and shipping methods within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWrapper
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ShippingEstimateWrapper with specified dispatcher, cart, and ship group.

methods.name: ShippingEstimateWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with cart data, loads shipping methods, estimates, and shipment times.

methods.name: loadShippingMethods
methods.description: Loads available shipping methods for the product store and shipping context.

methods.name: loadEstimates
methods.description: Calculates shipping cost estimates for each available shipping method considering the cart and allowances.

methods.name: loadShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Retrieves estimated delivery times for each shipping method.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping methods.

methods.name: getAllEstimates
methods.description: Returns a map of shipping methods to their estimated costs.

methods.name: getShippingEstimate
methods.description: Returns the estimated shipping cost for a given shipping method.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimates
methods.description: Returns list of estimated delivery times.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Returns estimated delivery time in days for a given shipping method.
